sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 20.
Unison gauge reduction boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Activates Time Slice which reduces the time advantageous effects (buffs, special buffs, and non-removable buffs) are applied to the target by 70 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Abstraction for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 40.
-Target: yourself. Applies Phalanx for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects). Recover 100 Cost and fill your Unison gauge by 30 when this effect is removed).
-Applies Anguish Collapse (Ability Power decreases by 50 when attacking an enemy not in Break, applies Grief with a 10% to chance to increase damage received by 50%, disables Unison gauge filling effects) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 40000
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 60
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 40000
